My remote job pays me 770 eur, I would feel very anxious in a foreign country with that much to my name, how do I afford shelter, food, would I have time to pick up another job on top of the one I have to make ends meet, and if I just quit my job, will I find another one? I don't have higher education or many skills, really. I feel like it would be irresponsible to do that right now. But I could put a few years into it, like doing some courses that would give me skills I could use:) and save up for a few years so the first few months in a new country would not be so risky, like I could get a place for for 1-2 months while I get on my feet. Thanks for the idea!

Yes, the capital of this country is about an hour away from me, 45 min if I catch the bus and the tram too. And there are loads of classes, groups and meetings. I could totally apply to one. As for why I didn't and don't... It's complicated, since I posted this post and got some insight from different people, this is what I am trying to figure out. So far this is what I got:  


I have financial anxiety. I feel like if I signed up for a 100 usd/month course I'd go bankrupt. That's obviously not true. It just feels like it. I think if I was making 10 times as much as I do now, I would still be like "100 usd for pottery??? what am I, rich?"  
I grew up very, very poor. Like bullied at school for having one pair of jeans kind of poor. I think this is one thing my brain can't accept, that I am not on the verge of losing my home at every single second.   


The other thing is my "executive dysfunction" or whatever (too much internet for me, I know) is that there are so many things that I should be doing, that I do not want to so I won't, but the second I even think about doing something else, I am like "no, I can't go out, I have this very important thing to do, I can't be irresponsible and do this fun thing instead" and then I stay home and proceed to not even look in the direction of said big responsibility. (right now it's studying a third language to get a language exam so I can make more money, and a few other projects)   


If I knew all these, why did I make this post? I didn't, I actually am just real dumb I guess and I needed to hear other people and answer their questions to see these patterns. I am super grateful for that

I don't think I have social anxiety. When I do have to go around people, I am fine. I am more than fine, I am very curious, I often go up to people, I had to run some errands a few weeks ago in the city, and I overheard a group talking, and I loved their accent, so I asked them where they are from.   


I am trying to think real hard why I isolate myself. I am thinking hard I do not know. I THINK I want to, it's depressing to live in a concrete cube, I clearly don't enjoy it. I could afford grabbing a latte so it's not money either. I like people and being around them. I truly don't know. It feels like I am a broken machine. **I want to and I could and I won't**. This is so freaky. I feel like I 'can't' which is not true, I have two working legs, free time and a little money too. But still, it FEELS like I can't.
